scenes.text: Meet Trackly. Project management with sign-off built in, so nothing moves forward until the right people approve it.
Your dashboard shows what needs you today: your work, the approvals waiting for you, and how every project is doing.
Inside a project, every feature follows a clear lifecycle: from proposed, through design, development and testing, all the way to release.
When a stage is done, the project owner or a manager signs it off in one click, and the feature moves to the next stage.
Team members can request sign-off. Approvers see exactly what is waiting for them, and the first one to decide settles it.
Link features to milestones, and they move together. When its features are signed off, the milestone follows.
Day-to-day work lives on the board, with issues, priorities and owners, updated live for the whole team.
Keep an eye on money too. Set a budget for each project, and Trackly turns logged hours into costs, so you always know what is spent and what is left.
When the team needs to talk, built-in chat keeps conversations right next to the work, with group chats, direct messages, replies and reactions.
The roadmap keeps every date in view across all your projects.
Each company gets its own private workspace, with its own workspace ID, two-factor sign-in and security controls.
And you decide what your team sees. Switch modules on or off to keep Trackly as simple as you need.
Trackly. Plan it, build it, sign it off. Start your free fourteen-day trial today.
